Local document-reader dependencies: Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0), Arabic/English traineddata from tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast. All assets are self-hosted; document bytes remain in browser during extraction. PDF scan limit: first 5 pages. Proposed Gregorian dates require human confirmation. See adjacent licenses.

Dawamkom local patch: pdf.worker.mjs imports ../../pdf-font-recovery.js to recover missing ToUnicode maps from an embedded Unicode cmap only for Identity-H/V composite fonts with a complete, unambiguous Arabic-Indic digit set. Explicit PDF ToUnicode maps are never replaced. This addresses Ministry of Commerce PDFs whose glyph IDs otherwise appear as Greek/combining characters. Preserve or re-evaluate this patch when upgrading PDF.js. Extracted numeric Hijri dates use Intl Umm al-Qura conversion and retain the original date; expiry suggestions require human confirmation. OCR word coordinates can associate printed expiry labels with embedded native date text; no cloud AI transmission or paid OCR is used.
